audit: finite prioritized read-only optional Basic.assert essential effects
scope: Jai handwritten stdlib/internal and handwritten public facades; optional runtime Basic.assert arguments. Extensions, generated native declaration bodies, tests/self-tests and #assert compile-time checks excluded from defect claims.
method: rg discovery (987 initial internal assertion lines), direct caller/callee/data-flow review of call-containing candidates, exact current source lines/hashes. Search hits alone are not findings. Pure comparisons/casts/size/type queries are not bug claims. This is a prioritized finite audit, not an exhaustive transitive purity proof.

optional_assert_semantics.effect: ENABLE_ASSERT=false uses #discard for all assert arguments; they are unevaluated

reproduction.compiler: fresh cargo build --locked --offline -p jaic-cli in worker-only T7 compiler directory
reproduction.config: isolated current shared stdlib copy; only Basic/module.jai ENABLE_ASSERT default true -> false; source-copy hashes and exact diff/hashes in receipt; production default remains true
reproduction.loaded_instance_proof: Unparameterized Basic imported by the reduction and GetRect/Keymap. bump in Basic.assert executes once enabled, zero times disabled in every mode; no separate parameterized caller instance.
reproduction.text_result: enabled ab, disabled a in all modes
reproduction.keymap_result: both host files present enabled and absent disabled in native O0/O2; interpreter host file presence not established
reproduction.limits: No Windows/Linux native, GUI suites or Android execution; unchanged required platform gates
reproduction.text_module: GetRect (right-handed) executed; GetRect_LeftHanded loads the same audited body but was not separately executed

changed_during_audit.current_state: Owner independently moved buffer_write and pack buffer_read out of assertions. read_pack_field executes read, then logs/asserts false/returns false on mismatch. Static audit resolves old essential-effect pattern; owner owns runtime regression.

prior_fixed_examples.current_state: H.table_add executes outside assert at clone_object before memcpy/recursive copy; remaining assertions are predicates.
unlock_states computes compare_and_swap into released before B.assert(released); locking outside optional assertions.
